value.rationale: An all-dimensional exact Ehrhart series for a geometric cube/cross-polytope polar interpolation and a sharp nonmonotone minimal-period transition in two successive dimensions expose an arithmetic effect invisible from known isotropic and radial-shell geometry. The odd-dimensional absence of a second-root pole is a uniform structural theorem.
